usedFor: HelloLeads CRM holds new leads and Freshsales Classic holds deals, so “New Lead Added” can run “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Added” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new lead gets a deal with its stage and close date, and the contact is created if missing.

watchOut: “New Lead Added” in HelloLeads CRM is polling, so “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic runs after a scheduled check.
